content: pg_get_expr(indpred, indrelid) renders the stored, normalized partial-index predicate. Verified on PG 16.2 that the rendered text depends on the READER's search_path: with core absent from search_path enum literals render as 'active'::core.access_grant_status; with SET search_path TO core they render as 'active'::access_grant_status. Any exact-string predicate assertion must pin search_path or strip schema qualification.
